games.name: VRChat
games.vr_evidence: Steam lists VR support and tracked-controller support.
games.social_evidence: The official description identifies VRChat as social VR with online multiplayer.
games.embodied_presence_evidence: The official description documents avatars with full-range motion, eye tracking, lip sync and avatar interactions, so other people are present as motion-driven bodies rather than abstract multiplayer markers.
games.popularity_evidence: The Steam store shows more than 1000 user reviews.
